request_payload.title: Long-Term Open-Label Study Evaluating Oral Miglustat Treatment in Patients With Neuronal Ceroid Lipofuscinosis Type 3.

mentions.sentence: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis type 3 (CLN3) is a rare lysosomal storage disorder characterized by progressive neurodegeneration.
Miglustat, a substrate reduction therapy, has shown preclinical efficacy in CLN3 models (conference abstract).
